subject: Provisioning proofs & session-sampling for AcmeLeap SOC2 intake
messages:
From: Jake Porter <security@acmeleap.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@acmeleap.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Provisioning and session sampling request for SOC2 intake

Hi Soojin,

We're starting the SOC2 intake for AcmeLeap and need a narrow set of IAM artifacts to validate provisioning and session behavior. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following within two weeks?

- SCIM delta export (sample of user create/update/delete events) covering the last 90 days, ideally CSV with timestamps and externalIds
- SAML assertion samples (raw assertion text) spanning at least three different login sessions, with NameID and assertion IDs preserved
- RBAC matrix / role-owner mapping for production orgs (who is owner for each role)
- A sample of session traces / authentication logs for interactive web sessions (redacted PII OK) covering a 7-day window
- List of service accounts and service principals, and their provisioning timestamps

Delivery options: SFTP, Drive link, or encrypted email. Also let us know any restrictions on redaction (we prefer NameID preserved). If two weeks is tight, a staged delivery is fine — start with a small SCIM + SAML sample and we can iterate.

Thanks,
Jake Porter
Security Manager — AcmeLeap
attachments: none
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Jake Porter <security@acmeleap.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning and session sampling request for SOC2 intake

Jake — thanks for the clear list. We can support this scope; a couple of clarifying points before we assemble artifacts: 

1) SCIM sample: do you need full attribute dumps (emails, phone) or are timestamp + externalId + changeType sufficient? We can provide a redacted CSV if PII is a concern.
2) SAML assertions: you said NameID must be preserved — we can keep NameID but will redact email addresses if requested. Do you need the full certificate chain included in the sample?
3) Session traces: are you asking for HTTP session logs, or our internal token/session store traces (KV cache hits, SSO assertion timestamps)? We can provide both, but token-level traces will include internal IDs that we'd prefer to redact.
4) Preferred transfer: Drive link is easiest for us; we can also stage an SFTP drop.

Proposed owners and timeline: Jordan will own the SCIM + RBAC extraction; Marcus will own the session and assertion sampling. I will coordinate redaction and delivery.

We can produce the initial SCIM + one SAML assertion sample and the RBAC ownership matrix within 5 business days. Full session traces for 7 days will take longer (7-10 business days) because of sensitive data redaction. Is that acceptable?

Attachments (placeholders):
- rbac_owner_matrix.xlsx (template filled with current prod roles)
- scim_delta_sample.csv (redacted example)
- workback_schedule.pdf (proposed delivery timeline)

If that plan works, we'll start extraction tomorrow morning and share a Drive folder.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: rbac_owner_matrix.xlsx, scim_delta_sample.csv, workback_schedule.pdf
From: Jake Porter <security@acmeleap.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@acmeleap.com
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning and session sampling request for SOC2 intake

Appreciate the quick turn. A couple of clarifications:

- SCIM: timestamp + externalId + changeType is fine for the sample; we will request full attribute dumps later if needed.
- SAML assertions: please preserve NameID and AssertionID. We need at least one assertion that includes the authnInstant and an AttributeStatement. No certificate chain required for the sample.
- Session traces: prefer HTTP session logs (redacted IPs fine) that show the SAML handshake flow and token issuance timestamps. If you can include a mapping to the internal session id, that helps but not required.

Drive delivery is preferred. We can accept a staged approach: SCIM + SAML + RBAC first, then session traces in the second drop.

Also: any possibility to include one example of a SCIM delta showing a role change (role assignment added/removed)? That will speed verification.

Thanks — legal has been looped for record keeping.

-Jake

On Tue, May 12, 2026 at 11:02 AM Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jake — thanks for the clear list. We can support this scope; a couple of clarifying points before we assemble artifacts:

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Jake Porter <security@acmeleap.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 17:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning and session sampling request for SOC2 intake

Jake — delivering the initial artifact bundle as discussed. Links and brief notes below.

Drive folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_AcmeLeap-intake
HubSpot intake record: hubspot://deal/ACMLEAP-4581

Included files (redacted where noted):
- scim_delta_sample.csv — 90-day delta, includes externalId, changeType, timestamp, role assignment indicator (redacted emails: yes)
- saml_assertion_samples.txt — three raw assertions (NameID and AssertionID preserved; certificate headers removed)
- rbac_owner_matrix.xlsx — role → owner mapping for prod orgs (owner is an internal alias; real names available on request)
- session_trace_sample_redacted.log — 7-day HTTP session trace, IPs redacted, includes SAML handshake timestamps and session IDs mapped to NameIDs
- workback_schedule.pdf — proposed second-drop schedule for full session traces & service account list

Notes / constraints:
- We preserved NameID and AssertionID per request; emails in SCIM were redacted but externalIds are present to map back to your system.
- For full session traces that include unredacted IPs or PII we'll need an executed NDA amendment or secure SFTP drop that meets our data handling policy.
- If you need a CSV extract showing a SCIM role_change event specifically, Jordan can run a narrow export and drop it into the same Drive folder — ping me with the window you'd like sampled.

Follow-up next steps: Jordan will drop the role-change CSV if you confirm the window; Marcus will start preparing the token-store traces for the second drop and will estimate redaction effort once we agree on the IP/PII handling.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments included: scim_delta_sample.csv, saml_assertion_samples.txt, rbac_owner_matrix.xlsx, session_trace_sample_redacted.log, workback_schedule.pdf
